name: Scarlet-naped Myzomela
rangeDescription: Buka, bougainville, shortland, fauro, choiseul, and santa isabel (northern solomon islands)
description: Mostly yellowish with a black head, back, tail, and shoulders. Wing feathers fringed with yellow.

name: Yemen Linnet
rangeDescription: Mountains of southwestern arabia
description: A fine-billed finch with a notched tail. Male is neatly patterned, with a dusty orange back and flanks contrasting sharply with sandy gray hood and rump; also note pale central belly stripe.

name: Pied Stilt
rangeDescription: Indonesia to australia and new zealand; winters to philippines
description: Large black-and-white shorebird with long straight, needle-like bill, and very long pink legs. Note black hind-neck.

name: Rufous-vented Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Eastern bhutan to northeastern india, northern myanmar, and northern laos
description: A large laughingthrush with a heavy black bill. Note black mask on face, yellow throat, and reddish belly.

name: Bertram's Weaver
rangeDescription: Highlands of tanzania, zambia, malawi, and northern mozambique
description: Fairly large, chunky weaver. Both sexes have a pale eye, an olive back, and yellow underparts.

name: Leyte Plumed-Warbler
rangeDescription: East-central philippines (leyte and samar)
description: A tiny and very little-known bird of foothill forest on Samar and Leyte islands. Yellow below, with a broad yellow eyebrow and olive upperparts.

name: Aleutian Tern
rangeDescription: Alaska and siberia; winters to singapore and indonesia
description: Beautiful, elegant tern of the Pacific Ocean. Breeding adults are silvery-gray overall with a black cap and crisp white forehead.

name: Black-capped Speirops
rangeDescription: São tomé island (gulf of guinea)
description: A bulky, gray-olive white-eye with a dark crown, a pinkish-brown bill, a broad white eye-ring, and a white line from shoulders to flanks. Small to large groups join mixed flocks in forest and plantation throughout São Tomé, but it prefers highland forest above 900 meters.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Buru Monarch
rangeDescription: Lowlands of buru (southern moluccas)
description: A little-known black-and-white flycatcher-like species restricted to the island of Buru. Has a black hood, a striking white facial mark below the eye, all-black upperparts, and white outer tail feathers, lower chest, and belly.

name: Yellow-throated Tanager
rangeDescription: Andes of southeastern colombia to ecuador and southeastern peru (puno)
description: A well-named and colorful tanager found in cloud forest along the east slope of the Andes. Blazing yellow throat stands out sharply against its otherwise mostly bluish plumage.

name: Rufous-gaped Hillstar
rangeDescription: Andes of southwestern colombia and northwestern ecuador
description: Large hummingbird with limited range on west slope of Andes from central Colombia to northwest Ecuador. Distinctive in range.

name: Smew
rangeDescription: Northern eurasia; winters to north africa, india, and eastern china
description: Generally uncommon and fairly local small diving duck. Frequents lakes, reservoirs, and rivers.

name: Cryptic Forest-Falcon
rangeDescription: Rainforest of brazil and northeastern bolivia
description: Beautiful forest-falcon, typically very difficult to see. Has a gray head and back, bare red facial skin, and white underparts with gray bars on the breast.

name: White-capped Tanager
rangeDescription: Locally in andes of colombia and western venezuela to southeastern peru
description: Large, boisterous, striking tanager unlikely to be mistaken. Mostly dark blackish, but look for satin-red throat and iridescent steely-bluish wings.

name: Green-tailed Emerald
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern venezuela (falcón to lara, sucre, and northern monagas)
description: Small, compact, short-billed and short-tailed hummingbird with green tail. Male all glittering green; female green above and gray below with dark cheek, white eyeline, and white-tipped tail.

name: Graceful Pitta
rangeDescription: Highlands of sumatra
description: Rare and secretive jewel of the Sumatran highlands. Found at 400-1400 meters in wet forest, especially in gullies and ravines.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Mindoro Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Highlands of mindoro (central philippines)
description: A large pigeon of montane forest canopy on Mindoro with a metallic green wing and rump, a bronzy back, a buffy throat, and gray underparts, sides of the neck, and crown. Note the red eye-ring and the broad gray central band in the black tail.

name: Orange-cheeked Waxbill
rangeDescription: Senegambia to democratic republic of the congo, northern angola, and northern zambia
description: A tiny finch of grassy areas. Key features include the brown back, red rump, orange face, and bright red bill.

name: Scripps's Murrelet
rangeDescription: Channel islands and islands off western coast of baja california
description: Small seabird, black above and white below. Breeds on rocky islands; otherwise found in warm offshore waters.

name: Corn Crake
rangeDescription: Palearctic; winters mediterranean to africa and madagascar
description: Extremely secretive inhabitant of wet grassland, meadows, and hayfields, mainly in wilder areas. Distinctive song can draw attention, given mainly early and late in the day, also often at night.
